ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which is the outer and narrower of two bones of the human lower leg, extending from the knee to the ankle?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a lateral skeletal schematic diagram of the foot and ankle, in which the foot bones, ankle joint, and two long bones extending downward from the lower leg to the ankle can be seen; one of them is thicker, and the other is thinner and located in the lateral ankle region. Then reason: the two main bones of the human lower leg are the tibia and fibula; the tibia is larger, more medial, and mainly bears weight, while the fibula is thinner and located laterally. Therefore, the lower-leg bone asked about in the question, “lateral and narrower,” is the fibula.
